resolution.note: Fix OMD == plain dict ignoring values

title: An ordered multi-dict compares equal to a plain dict whose values differ
body: Bug: an OrderedMultiDict built from [('a', 1), ('b', 2)] reports == True against {'a': 999, 'b': 2} when the multi-dict is on the left of the comparison, and != against it is False. The same happens for the multi-dict behind URL query parameters (QueryParamDict). Comparing a dict on the left already behaves.

acceptance.verify: PYTHONPATH=. mise exec pipx:pytest@9.2.0 -- pytest -q tests
